title: Duskers, the scary command line game, is getting a sequel
summary: Misfits Attic announces Duskers 2.0, a sequel to the cult classic horror game where players explore derelict spaceships using a command-line interface, continuing the unique text-based survival horror experience that distinguished the original.
problem_solved: Provides new narrative content and refined gameplay for fans of the original command-line horror game Duskers.
why_valuable: Delivers continuation of a unique horror gaming experience that combined atmospheric storytelling with unconventional command-line mechanics, appealing to fans of unconventional indie games.
